All source guards execute in order; n>1 divisibility and batch division, both cache layouts, actual stride wiring, full3D grid and head_dim num_warps branch are retained. Natural n=0 reaches an empty grid; no n=1 or single-layout restriction.
Every program executes the existing complete signed source, with fresh registers and actual3D coordinates. Memory is threaded between programs, preserving all aliases and repeated writes.

Complete final-memory equality and all untouched cells are proved against independent current-memory address/value recurrence. Reshape-copy preservation is proved for every original4D strided element.

No numerical callback law, successful-execution premise, arbitrary post-reshape stride premise, or no-alias hypothesis is required.
